_comment: Bench baseline targets for the N=10 CI smoke. Numbers are upper-bound expectations sampled from a colima-on-macOS run; native-Linux GitHub runners typically come in well under these. The regress gate uses tolerance=3.0x for the smoke (config in .github/workflows/ci.yml), so anything within 3x of these targets passes. Tighter human-driven 100-session runs use the default tolerance=2.0x.
